name: umbra-btc-checkpoint-relay-worker
description: Standalone checkpoint_relay proving worker — keeps ShieldedVault.checkpoints[BTC_SIGNET_SOURCE_CHAIN_ID] advancing with real, proven 6-header hops instead of an admin write (see contract/contracts/ShieldedVault.sol's extendCheckpoint). Deliberately NOT part of the backend/ deployment (same reasoning as btc-deposit-worker/, see its own README) and NOT btc-deposit-worker's own Lambda (different cadence — this paces real signet block production, not per-deposit demand). Run this wherever you have real compute for Noir/Barretenberg proving; it talks to a running backend over HTTP for everything, including submission — same reasoning as btc-deposit-worker/matcher-worker for never holding a gas key itself.

scripts.package-lambda: pnpm run build && pnpm run sync-circuit && node scripts/package-lambda.js
